lines.en: label iospring4:
scene lr2_noon
I did some cleaning today.
lines.zh: 我今天做了些打扫。

lines.en: Or tried to, at least.
lines.zh: 至少试着做了。

lines.en: Ami has always been better at that sort of thing. And Niki’s good at anything if she puts her mind to it.
lines.zh: Ami 向来比我擅长这种事。而 Niki 只要肯用心，什么都能做得好。

lines.en: It’s still new to me, though.
lines.zh: 不过对我来说，这还是件新鲜事。

lines.en: Pathetic, I know. But I’ve yet to figure out which chemical concoctions best erase water stains. Or which type of vinegar is the one I’m supposed to use to prevent mold.
lines.zh: 很可悲，我知道。但我还没弄清楚，到底哪种化学勾兑出来的玩意儿最能擦掉水渍。或者到底该用哪种醋来防霉。

lines.en: I can’t be bothered to look it up either. I just can’t find the motivation. I just don’t care enough.
lines.zh: 我也懒得去查。我就是找不到动力。我就是不够在乎。

lines.en: It’s satisfying, though.
lines.zh: 不过这挺让人满足的。

lines.en: Not the act of cleaning itself, but taking a step back and looking at all you’ve managed to accomplish in just a brief window of time.
lines.zh: 不是打扫这个动作本身，而是退后一步，看着自己在短短一段时间里竟然完成了这么多。

lines.en: Or in my case — how you have accomplished nothing in a window so large that the house itself could fall through it.
lines.zh: 或者在我的情况里——看着自己在一个大到连房子都能掉下去的时间段里，一事无成。

lines.en: It’s satisfying because it’s validating. Just it validates that I am not cut out for this. And I am satisfied because I’ve always loved the way it feels to be right.
lines.zh: 它让人满足，是因为它验证了什么。它验证了我不适合干这个。而我之所以满足，是因为我一向喜欢「自己是对的」这种感觉。

lines.en: I’ve been using that word a lot lately.
lines.zh: 我最近用这个词用得很多。

lines.en: {i}Love.{/i}
I’ve been handing it out like candy.
lines.zh: 我一直像发糖一样把它到处送人。

lines.en: show sakinormal
For some reason, when I close my eyes, I can almost taste it.
lines.zh: 不知为什么，我一闭上眼睛，几乎能尝到它的味道。

lines.en: {i}That{/i} was like vinegar too.
lines.zh: {i}那{/i}味道也像醋。

lines.en: Just it didn’t work the way it was supposed to.
lines.zh: 只不过它并没有按应有的方式起作用。

lines.en: Mold still grows within me to this very day.
lines.zh: 直到今天，霉菌依旧在我体内生长。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 进来。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp1
: Hi! Hello. I’m here to annoy you again. This time, with the 1997 PC Classic, Theme Hospital.
lines.zh: : 嗨！你好。我又来烦你了。这次带着 1997 年的 PC 经典《主题医院》。

lines.en: : Jumping back even further in time, huh? Don’t girls your age typically like modern things more?
lines.zh: : 时间往回跳得更远了啊？你这个年纪的女生不是通常更喜欢现代的东西吗？

lines.en: : I’m going to give you a second to think about what you just said so you can find the flaws yourself without me having to point them out.
lines.zh: : 我给你一秒钟想想你刚刚说了什么，好让你自己找出毛病，免得我得替你指出来。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re here, Io.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你来了，Io。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp2
: You are? Why? I suck.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么？我很烂的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but so do I. So being around someone equally shitty makes me somehow feel a little {i}less{/i} shitty.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我也很烂。所以跟一个同样烂的人待在一起，反而让我觉得自己{i}没那么{/i}烂了。

lines.en: if iosex == True:
: Well, I don’t know if I’d say I’m {i}equally{/i} shitty. I think you took the crown that time you had sex with me. But still, I’m probably a close second.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不确定自己算「{i}同样{/i}烂」。我觉得那次你跟我上床的时候，这顶桂冠就已经归你了。不过话说回来，我大概能排个紧随其后的第二。

lines.en: else:
: You’re not shitty at all, though. You’re like my cool, guardian angel — who watches over me and prevents me from feeling like I’m the worst thing in the world.
lines.zh: : 可你一点都不烂啊。你就像我那个又酷又可靠的守护天使——守护着我，让我不觉得自己是世界上最糟糕的东西。

lines.en: : I literally {i}just{/i} called you shitty.
lines.zh: : 我{i}刚刚{/i}明明才说你很烂。

lines.en: : Yeah, in comparison to {i}you{/i}, who is decidedly {i}un-{/i}shitty.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但那是跟{i}你{/i}比，而你显然一点都{i}不{/i}烂。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp3
: Either way! Let’s go play games in your room so I stop feeling like I was only put here to suffer!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！我们去你房间打游戏吧，这样我就不会再觉得自己被生下来只是为了受苦了！

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : No! Of course not! Nothing is ever okay! Which is a huge part of why a lot of people play games in the first place!
lines.zh: : 不好！当然不好！从来就没有好过！而这也正是很多人一开始玩游戏的一大原因！

lines.en: : But before I go on a tirade about how that statement applies to the endless rollercoaster, no pun intended, that is my life, how about you just agree and show me to your room?!
lines.zh: : 不过在我开始长篇大论地讲这句话怎么适用于我的人生那趟没完没了的过山车（此处没有双关）之前，你要不要直接答应我，然后带我去你的房间？！

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: if iosex == True:
scene iothemehosp4
: Don’t worry, Sensei. I won’t be the only one having fun. I have something in store for you too.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Sensei。不会只有我一个人玩得开心的。我也给你准备了点东西。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to ask what it is?
lines.zh: : 我可以问问是什么吗？

lines.en: : I’d really prefer you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我真的宁愿你别问。

lines.en: scene black
else:
scene iothemehosp5

: If you’re still feeling bad about what happened the last time I came over and did something like this, don’t be. That was {i}my{/i} fault for putting myself in a situation where I knew it could happen.
lines.zh: : 如果你还在为上回我来你家、然后发生了那种事而自责，别这样。那是{i}我自己{/i}的错，是我把自己放进了那个我明知道会出事的情境里。

lines.en: : But I know you aren’t going to hurt me now. So there’s nothing you need to worry about. Just sit back and let me bother you. I need you today.
lines.zh: : 但我知道你现在不会伤害我了。所以你没什么好担心的。就坐回去，让我烦你吧。我今天需要你。

lines.en: : You need me?
lines.zh: : 你需要我？

lines.en: scene iothemehosp6
: I mean, realistically, I kind of need you {i}every{/i} day since when I’m {i}not{/i} with you, I’m still thinking about you. But, yeah. Today I guess I {i}really{/i} need you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，现实点讲，我大概{i}每天{/i}都需要你，因为我{i}不{/i}在你身边的时候，脑子里也还是在想你。不过，是啊。今天我大概是{i}真的{/i}需要你。

lines.en: : And you don’t want to talk about {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 而你不想说说是{i}为什么{/i}？

lines.en: scene iothemehosp5
: Nope. I just want to sit in the dark with my favorite person and forget all about it. Please help?
lines.zh: : 不想。我只想和我最喜欢的人一起坐在黑暗里，把一切都忘掉。帮帮忙好吗？

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 求————求你了？

lines.en: : Okay, fine. And I promise not to invite you into bed this time.
lines.zh: : 好，好吧。而且我保证这次不会把你拉上床。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp7
: Fuck yeah! Affection!
lines.zh: : 太他妈好了！纯粹的亲昵！

lines.en: scene iothemehosp5
: You can totally invite me into bed if you want, though. I’d let you hug the life out of me if you felt like it. It’s just all that {i}other{/i} stuff I can’t stomach. But you already know that, so-
lines.zh: : 不过你要是想把我拉上床，也完全可以。你要是想抱我，抱到断气都行。只是{i}别的那些{/i}我还是受不了。不过你已经知道了，所以——

lines.en: : I sure do. Let’s just go to my room, okay?
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。咱们就去我房间吧，好吗？

lines.en: scene black
: You clearly want to talk more about your weird retro hospital game than your feelings right now and, as always, I am fully supportive of avoiding any and all trauma dumping.
lines.zh: : 比起你的感受，你现在显然更想聊你那个诡异的复古医院游戏，而我一如既往地全力支持你回避一切形式的倒苦水。

lines.en: : Fuck yeah! Emotional cowardice!
lines.zh: : 太他妈好了！情感上的懦弱！

lines.en: I lead Io to the bedroom.
lines.zh: 我把 Io 领进卧室。

lines.en: She doesn’t notice how unclean everything is.
lines.zh: 她没有注意到一切都多么不干净。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp8
Or maybe she does and she just ignores it. Maybe she’s being polite?
lines.zh: 又或者她注意到了，只是假装没看见。也许她是在讲礼貌？

lines.en: Maybe she’s {i}used{/i} to filth by now after all that’s happened to her? And how I’ve surely only added to that by rubbing off on her over time.
lines.zh: 又或者，在经历了那么多之后，她已经{i}习惯{/i}了肮脏？更别提我这些日子跟她混在一起，肯定又给她添了几分。

lines.en: We sit with our shoulders close together. They brush against each other every once in a while — each one accompanied by a small flinch before she remembers I don’t {i}want{/i} to hurt her. I just {i}will.{/i}
lines.zh: 我们肩并肩坐着。肩膀偶尔会碰到一起——每一次她都会微微一缩，然后才想起我并不{i}想{/i}伤害她。我只是{i}终究会{/i}伤害她。

lines.en: : It needs to install first. It might take a second.
lines.zh: : 得先安装。可能要花点时间。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’ll just be thankful for this moment of awkward silence in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 没关系。那我就先好好享受这片刻尴尬的沉默吧。

lines.en: : And {i}I’ll{/i} be thankful your laptop still has a disc drive that allows me to install this in the first place. Those aren’t exactly common anymore.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我要{/i}感谢你的笔记本还带着光驱，让我能把它装上。那东西现在可不太常见了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, when it comes to being behind the times in terms of technology and...the Internet...and the concept of growing up as a whole, I’m your guy.
lines.zh: : 是啊，嗯，要说在科技、还有……互联网……乃至「长大成人」这件事整体上全面落伍，我就是你要找的人。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp9
: What’s in the “Math Homework” folder on your desktop?
lines.zh: : 你桌面上那个「数学作业」文件夹里是什么？

lines.en: : Math homework. I am a very organized, intellectual man.
lines.zh: : 数学作业。我是个非常有条理、有学识的男人。

lines.en: : It’s porn, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是色情片，对吧？

lines.en: scene iothemehosp10
: I don’t even know what that means. As I said, I am very behind the times in terms of technology and-
lines.zh: : 我连那是什么意思都不知道。正如我说的，我在科技方面非常落伍，而且——

lines.en: : So you don’t mind if I open it then.
lines.zh: : 那我打开看看你也不介意咯。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp11
: Please don’t. A man’s math homework folder should remain hidden from even those he trusts the most.
lines.zh: : 别。一个男人的数学作业文件夹，就算是对他最信任的人也该保持隐秘。

lines.en: : There’s some weird stuff in there, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 里面有些奇怪的东西吧？

lines.en: : I’m surprised you even want to know given who you are as a person.
lines.zh: : 考虑到你是个什么样的人，我倒挺惊讶你居然想知道。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp10
: I work in a bathhouse. I’m used to nudity, Sensei. Besides, I think it’s kind of funny. Like...porn as a whole. Would I watch it on my own? No. But I won’t think less of you for doing it.
lines.zh: : 我在澡堂工作。我早就习惯看裸体了，Sensei。再说了，我觉得这挺好笑的。就像……色情片这整件事。我自己会看吗？不会。但我不会因为你看了就瞧不起你。

lines.en: : Unless you still have those pictures of Uta from when she was a kid in there.
lines.zh: : 除非你里面还存着 Uta 小时候的那些照片。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp12
: Put you on the spot, huh?
lines.zh: : 戳到你痛处了，嗯？

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. It’s not really my place to weigh in anymore now that she’s straight up told both of us that she’s okay with you having them.
lines.zh: : 别担心。其实已经轮不到我来说三道四了，毕竟她已经直截了当地跟我们两个说过，她不介意你留着它们。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp13
: Oh, look! It finished installing.
lines.zh: : 哦，看！装好了。

lines.en: : You...{i}can{/i} weigh in if you want.
lines.zh: : 你……想说就{i}说{/i}吧。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp14
: I think it’s...great that you want to protect your friend. And I know that holding onto something I never should have had in the first place was wrong.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你想保护自己的朋友，这很好。而且我知道，留着一个我本来就不该拥有的东西，是错的。

lines.en: : So...you can weigh in. You can call me out. I know you haven’t gotten it all out of your system yet.
lines.zh: : 所以……你可以说。你可以骂我。我知道你还没把心里的话全倒出来。

lines.en: if iosex == True:
: You already know how bad I {i}can{/i} be, so-
lines.zh: : 你已经知道我{i}能{/i}有多坏了，所以——

lines.en: else:
: Just because I...left {i}you{/i} alone...doesn’t mean I-
lines.zh: : 就算我……丢下{i}你{/i}一个人……也不代表我——

lines.en: : There are a lot of really bad people in this world, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这个世界上有很多很坏的人，Sensei。

lines.en: : We both know that.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都知道。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp15
: But not all of them understand that what they’re doing is even wrong to begin with. Like that douchebag who posted Uta’s pictures online in the first place.
lines.zh: : 但不是所有人都明白，自己做的事从一开始就是错的。比如最先把 Uta 的照片发到网上的那个混蛋。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp16
: {i}Or the woman who used to torture me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}或者那个曾经折磨我的女人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You don’t have to-{/i}
: {i}I mean, it’s not fine. But there’s no sense in hiding it from you anymore now that it’s out in the open. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是说，这没什么好说的。但既然已经摊开了，再瞒着你也没什么意义。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Like, shit, the whole fucking class probably knows after that stupid trivia show thing. And talking about it always just makes it worse, but...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就说，操，那个破问答节目之后，全班搞不好都知道了。而且每次谈起它只会让事情更糟，不过……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}On the off chance that a place like Heaven exists, cursing her any chance I get can remind the gods or...angels or...whoever makes the guest list to keep her off of it. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}万一真有天堂这种地方存在，我逮着机会就诅咒她，也许能提醒那些神啊……天使啊……或者随便谁负责列宾客名单的，把她排除在外。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Even Hell would be too cold for a demon like her.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就连地狱，对她那样的恶魔来说都太冷了。{/i}

lines.en: : You’re going to be good, right?
lines.zh: : 你会乖的，对吧？

lines.en: : Because you know what will happen if you {i}aren’t{/i} good, right?
lines.zh: : 因为你知道如果你{i}不乖{/i}会发生什么，对吧？

lines.en: : You’ll send Sir Meowington back to the shelter.
lines.zh: : 你会把 Meowington 爵士送回收容所。

lines.en: : And?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : No dinner. No computer. No games. No anything.
lines.zh: : 没有晚饭。没有电脑。没有游戏。什么都没有。

lines.en: : And if the doctor asks you how you’re feeling? Do you remember that too?
lines.zh: : 要是医生问你感觉怎么样呢？那个你也还记得吧？

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time getting adjusted to my new school.
lines.zh: : 我很难适应新学校。

lines.en: : Because?
lines.zh: : 因为什么？

lines.en: : Because everyone hates me.
lines.zh: : 因为大家都讨厌我。

lines.en: : That’s not what we discussed.
lines.zh: : 我们可不是这么说的。

lines.en: : It’s the truth, though.
lines.zh: : 可这是事实。

lines.en: : Do you know {i}why{/i} they hate you, Io?
lines.zh: : 你知道他们{i}为什么{/i}讨厌你吗，Io？

lines.en: : Because I’m not like them.
lines.zh: : 因为我和他们不一样。

lines.en: : Because you’re an ungrateful, disobedient, obnoxious little brat who insists on ruining the lives of {i}everyone{/i} you speak to.
lines.zh: : 因为你是个不知感恩、不听话、讨人嫌的小屁孩，非要毁掉{i}每一个{/i}跟你说话的人的生活。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : Well, you won’t have to be sorry for long...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你也不用愧疚太久了……

lines.en: : You’ll be getting home-schooled as soon as that useless father of yours finishes the paperwork.
lines.zh: : 等你那个没用的父亲把手续办完，你就在家上学了。

lines.en: : You know what that means, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你知道那意味着什么吧？

lines.en: : You’ll be my teacher.
lines.zh: : 我会是你的老师。

lines.en: : And Mommy’s already taught you so much, hasn’t she? Are you excited to learn more?
lines.zh: : 而妈妈已经教过你那么多东西了，不是吗？想学更多，你兴不兴奋？

lines.en: : Can we just move again instead?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能换个地方住，别这样？

lines.en: : {i}What did you just say?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你刚刚说什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is why the kids at school hate you. {i}This{/i} is what makes you ungrateful.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是学校里的孩子讨厌你的原因。{i}这{/i}就是你不知感恩的表现。

lines.en: : I {i}made{/i} you. I put a roof over your head. I buy you nice clothes...all the games you want...those fucking {i}animals{/i} that {i}I{/i} have to feed, and {i}this{/i} is how you say thanks for all of that?
lines.zh: : 是我{i}造就{/i}了你。是我给你提供了栖身之所。我给你买漂亮的衣服……你想要的游戏全都买……还有那些{i}我得{/i}替你喂的该死的{i}动物{/i}，而你就是用{i}这种方式{/i}来感谢这一切的吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : No, you’re not. You’re never sorry. You’re a useless child who can’t follow even the simplest of directions. The kind that only a mother could love.
lines.zh: : 不，你不是。你从来没有对不起过。你是个连最简单的指示都照做不了的废物小孩。那种只有母亲才会爱的小孩。

lines.en: : What will you do if {i}I{/i} start to hate you next, Io? Where will you go? Are you going to live out on the street? Become a fucking {i}whore?{/i} Is {i}that{/i} your plan?
lines.zh: : 要是{i}我{/i}接着开始恨你，你打算怎么办，Io？你能去哪儿？你要去街上讨生活吗？去当个{i}婊子{/i}？{i}那{/i}就是你的计划吗？

lines.en: : I’ll be good.
lines.zh: : 我会乖的。

lines.en: : {i}Good.{/i} Because if you’re not, I’ll-
lines.zh: : {i}好{/i}。因为如果你不乖，我就——

lines.en: scene iothemehosp17
: Um...{i}excuse me?{/i} Can I help you?
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}不好意思{/i}？需要帮忙吗？

lines.en: scene iothemehosp18
: {i}Yasu! Move! What are you doing?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Yasu！让开！你在干什么？！{/i}

lines.en: : Would you mind controlling your child? My daughter has {i}anxiety.{/i} She’s not equipped to speak to random, weird little girls who want to stare at her for no fucking reason.
lines.zh: : 你能不能管管你的孩子？我女儿有{i}焦虑症{/i}。她可没本事去跟一个无缘无故盯着她看的奇怪小女孩说话。

lines.en: : I-I’m sorry. She’s not well. Yasu, move. {i}Now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我、我很抱歉。她不太舒服。Yasu，让开。{i}现在{/i}。

lines.en: : Bad woman...
lines.zh: : 坏女人……

lines.en: : I’m so sorry! She thinks she sees things! And she’s always hearing these {i}voices{/i} and-
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉！她总觉得自己在看见什么东西！而且还老是听见这些{i}声音{/i}，然后——

lines.en: : And you think I {i}care?!{/i} Get your fucking freak away from my little girl or I’ll call the police. This is harassment. Who’s your doctor? Are you even supposed to be here?
lines.zh: : 你以为我会{i}在乎{/i}吗？！把你那个该死的怪胎从我女儿身边弄走，不然我就报警了。这叫骚扰。你的医生是谁？你到底该不该来这儿？

lines.en: scene iothemehosp19
: S-Sorry! We were just leaving!
lines.zh: : 对、对不起！我们这就走！

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : {i}Shh! Will you ever stop embarrassing me?! You can't just stare at other girls like that! I don’t care what you think you heard! Just...be normal!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘘！你到底什么时候才能不再让我丢人？！你不能就这么盯着别的女孩子看！我不管你以为自己听见了什么！就……正常一点！{/i}

lines.en: : Tch. The nerve of some people.
lines.zh: : 啧。有些人可真够可以的。

lines.en: : Clearly, not everyone is cut out to be a mother.
lines.zh: : 显然，不是每个人都适合当母亲。

lines.en: scene black
: Go to the bathroom and fix your hair before your appointment. We can stop for ice cream on the way home if you do a good job.
lines.zh: : 去洗手间把头发整理好，然后去见医生。要是你表现得好，回家路上我们可以停下来买冰淇淋。

lines.en: : I’m tired. I don’t want ice cream.
lines.zh: : 我累了。我不想要冰淇淋。

lines.en: : Yes you do. You love ice cream. Now, go. You look like a fucking mess. Almost as bad as that other girl. People are going to think I abuse you. Do you {i}want{/i} that? Do you {i}want{/i} to make me look bad?
lines.zh: : 你要的。你最爱吃冰淇淋了。现在，去。你看上去一团糟。几乎跟刚才那个女孩一样糟。别人会以为我在虐待你。你{i}想要{/i}那样吗？你{i}想{/i}让我丢脸吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I-
lines.zh: : 对不起。我——

lines.en: : That’s it. No computer. No games. You’ll sit in your room and read until Mommy has a job for you. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 够了。没有电脑。没有游戏。你就坐在房间里看书，直到妈妈有活儿派给你。听懂了吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: if iosex == False:
scene iothemehosp20
: You’ve been...sitting there in silence for like five minutes now, Io.
lines.zh: : 你已经……在那儿沉默地坐了大概五分钟了，Io。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene iothemehosp21
: No, like...sorry for...zoning out. Uhh...where...
lines.zh: : 不，我是说……抱歉我……走神了。呃……刚才……

lines.en: : Where were we exactly?
lines.zh: : 我们说到哪儿了来着？

lines.en: : Something about Hell being too cold for-
lines.zh: : 好像是说地狱对——

lines.en: scene iothemehosp22
: Y-Yeah. Hell is too cold for people like her. Not you, though. And that’s pretty much all I have to say on the subject. Sorry if I made it sound like I had more. I-
lines.zh: : 是、是啊。地狱对她那样的人来说都太冷了。不过你不是。关于这个话题，我大概也就只有这么多了。抱歉我说得像是有很多话要讲似的。我——

lines.en: : So...this “Theme Hospital” game. What’s the point? What do you do?
lines.zh: : 那么……这个《主题医院》到底是玩什么的？要做什么？

lines.en: scene iothemehosp23
: Huh?
: You said it finished installing? I want to hear you explain it to me. What are we supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 你说装好了？我想听你给我讲讲。我们要做什么？

lines.en: : Am I...
: {i}Really{/i} safe now, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 现在{i}真的{/i}安全了吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : You’re in danger any time you’re near me, Io. I’m not going to pretend you’re not just because I decided against having sex with you {i}one time.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你只要在我身边就处于危险之中，Io。我不会因为有{i}一次{/i}决定不和你做爱，就假装你不是这样。

lines.en: : Do you want to have sex with me {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}现在{/i}想和我做爱吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太想，不想。

lines.en: : That’s two times then. {i}Now,{/i} will you say it?
lines.zh: : 那就是两次了。{i}那么{/i}，你愿意说出来吗？

lines.en: : Nope. We’re supposed to be playing the 1997 PC Classic, Theme Hospital. You wanted to {i}avoid{/i} feelings today, remember?
lines.zh: : 不。我们应该玩 1997 年的 PC 经典《主题医院》才对。你今天说好了要{i}回避{/i}感情的，记得吗？

lines.en: : I remember. But now my heart is beating out of my chest and I kind of want to just hug you and cry. But I also {i}hate{/i} crying so it’s a major conundrum. I’m not sure what to do.
lines.zh: : 我记得。可现在我的心跳快得要从胸口蹦出来了，而且我有点想就这么抱着你哭一场。但我又很{i}讨厌{/i}哭，所以这是个大难题。我不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : Give me your hand.
lines.zh: : 把你的手给我。

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Sorry. Do you need both hands to play this game? I figured holding onto one of mine might help us kill two birds with one stone.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你玩这个游戏需要两只手吗？我想，要是你能握着我的一只手，也许能让我们一举两得。

lines.en: : I can...play with one...
lines.zh: : 我可以……用一只手玩……

lines.en: : A-Anyway! The whole point of the game is to create a hospital that specializes in curing a bunch of weird diseases that-
lines.zh: : 总、总之！这个游戏的主旨就是经营一家医院，专门治疗一堆奇奇怪怪的病，然后——

lines.en: Io and I spend the rest of the afternoon holding hands and playing video games in the dark.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 手牵着手，在黑暗里打了一下午的游戏。

lines.en: I feel like a kid again. I imagine she does too.
lines.zh: 我感觉自己又变回了小孩。我想她也是。

lines.en: But I’m confused about why we like it.
lines.zh: 但我搞不懂我们为什么会喜欢这样。

lines.en: Eventually, she leaves. But she keeps the game here.
lines.zh: 最终，她走了。但她把游戏留在这儿了。

lines.en: I keep playing until it’s dark everywhere, not just in my room.
lines.zh: 我一直玩到到处都黑了，而不只是我的房间里。

lines.en: And before I know it, I’m looking down at a chat window full of pictures of my progress, with her name plastered to the top of it.
lines.zh: 而等我回过神来，我正低头看着一个满是进度截图的聊天窗口，最上面贴着她的名字。

lines.zh: : 你已经……在那儿沉默地坐了大概五分钟了，Io。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Because I’m sorry for everything. That’s just...how I am.
lines.zh: : 因为我为一切感到抱歉。那就是……我的样子。

lines.en: : I know it’s not my fault. But I still can’t help but say it. It’s like...a reflex, almost.
lines.zh: : 我知道那不是我的错。可我还是忍不住要说。就像……一种条件反射，差不多。

lines.en: : Like, if I’m not constantly apologizing, everything I care about is going to be taken away. And I’ll be all alone in the dark...in the glow of some old laptop, waiting for my pills to kick in.
lines.zh: : 就好像，只要我不停地道歉，我所在乎的一切就会被夺走。而我会独自一人留在黑暗里……留在一台旧笔记本的微光中，等着我的药起效。

lines.en: : Why can’t I be happy, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 为什么我没法幸福呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : I ask myself the same question all the time.
lines.zh: : 我也一直在问自己同样的问题。

lines.en: : But you know what will {i}make{/i} you happy....
lines.zh: : 但你知道什么会{i}让你幸福{/i}……

lines.en: scene iothemehosp25
: And it’s something {i}I{/i} can help with...
lines.zh: : 而那是{i}我{/i}能帮上忙的事……

lines.en: : So I will.
lines.zh: : 所以我会帮的。

lines.en: scene black
scene iothemehosp26
: Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : It’s hard.
lines.zh: : 好难。

lines.en: : Do you mind if it’s under the table?...
lines.zh: : 你介意在桌子底下吗？……

lines.en: : Do I mind if {i}what{/i} is under the table, Io?
lines.zh: : 你介意{i}什么{/i}在桌子底下，Io？

lines.en: : Are you asking because you genuinely don’t know? Or because you want to hear me say it?
lines.zh: : 你问这个是因为真的不知道？还是因为想听我说出来？

lines.en: : The latter — but only because I want you to snap out of whatever it is that’s going on with you right now.
lines.zh: : 后者——不过只是因为我想让你从现在这种状态里回过神来。

lines.en: : Let me make you happy, Sensei. As payment for spending time with me today. It's the least I can do.
lines.zh: : 让我让你幸福吧，Sensei。就当是今天陪我的报酬。这是我最起码能做的事。

lines.en: : You don’t need to {i}pay{/i} me, Io. You don’t need to do any of this.
lines.zh: : 你不需要{i}付{/i}我报酬啊，Io。你不需要做这些。

lines.en: : But it’s hard.
lines.zh: : 可是好难。

lines.en: : That means you want it, right?
lines.zh: : 那就是说明你想要，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course I {i}want{/i} it, but-
lines.zh: : 我当然{i}想要{/i}，但是——

lines.en: : It’s just my hand...
lines.zh: : 只是我的手而已……

lines.en: : This much, I can stomach.
lines.zh: : 这种程度，我还受得了。

lines.en: : It’s so big...
lines.zh: : 好大……

lines.en: : You’re so-
lines.zh: : 你好——

lines.en: scene iothemehosp27
: No.
scene iothemehosp28
: No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : But I...
lines.zh: : 可我……

lines.en: : I started it. {i}I{/i} chose to do this. So you don’t have to feel guilty about-
lines.zh: : 是我开始的。是{i}我自己{/i}选择要做这个。所以你不必觉得内疚——

lines.en: : I said no.
lines.zh: : 我说不要。

lines.en: : Do you know what that word means?
lines.zh: : 你知道那个词是什么意思吗？

lines.en: : To me, it meant nothing for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，它在很长一段时间里毫无意义。

lines.en: : And now?
lines.zh: : 那现在呢？

lines.en: : Now, I’m just...confused.
lines.zh: : 现在，我只是……很困惑。

lines.en: : Do you like me or...do you not like me?
lines.zh: : 你到底喜不喜欢我？

lines.en: : I like you. But I’m not going to force you to do anything.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你。但我不会强迫你做任何事。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp29
: But...you’re not! Like I said, this is {i}my{/i} choice! {i}I{/i} intended to do this today!
lines.zh: : 可是……你没有啊！就像我说的，这是我{i}自己{/i}选的！{i}我{/i}今天本来就打算这么做的！

lines.en: : Okay. Then I won’t let you force {i}yourself{/i} either.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那么我也不会让你强迫{i}你自己{/i}。

lines.en: : Why...not?
lines.zh: : 为……什么不要？

lines.en: : Because I never want to see you like that again.
lines.zh: : 因为我不想再看到你那个样子了。

lines.en: scene iothemehosp30
: I never want to see you like that again either...
lines.zh: : 我也不想再看到你那个样子了……

lines.en: : Was it scary?

lines.en: : Yeah.
: But you still like me either way? You’re not just lying about it because you’re afraid of change?
lines.zh: : 可你还是照样喜欢我？你不是在因为害怕改变而撒谎吧？

lines.en: : I like you...a lot.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你……很喜欢。

lines.en: : Then take your hand off of me...
lines.zh: : 那就把你的手从我身上拿开……

lines.en: : Okay?
lines.zh: : 好吗？
